verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS feedback platform like Canny, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The SDK, widget, SSO, secure-identify and MCP items cover user identification and data access, not opting out of tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
